status.evidence: According to UK Companies House, Airmax Remote Limited is an active company and Airmax Holdings Limited was notified as a person with significant control in December 2021.

claims.claim: Airmax Remote reports that its core cloud infrastructure, hosted on Microsoft Azure, operates with a 99.9% service level agreement (SLA) uptime and a 99.98% uptime for its Maps API.

The company reports that its MaxCam connected vehicle dash camera utilizes built-in high-speed 4G LTE Cat.6 connectivity to upload video clips within minutes of an event, while its third-generation Remote Telematics Unit (RTU) relies on a multi-constellation antenna supporting GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, and BeiDou tracking combined with a 2G/LTE-M cellular modem.

A case study reported by Great British Fleet Event highlights that energy generator Infinis deployed the Airmax Remote telematics solution across its fleet, with 2018–2019 data analysis showing a 39% decrease in harsh acceleration and a 2% reduction in harsh braking among drivers.

The company reports that its third-generation Remote Telematics Unit (RTU) connects directly to a vehicle's diagnostics servicing connector (EOBD/OBD), features a 15–30 minute plug-and-play installation with accelerometer auto-alignment, and offers cross-vehicle compatibility with around 98% of typical fleet vehicles.

The company reports the integration of its MaxCam connected vehicle dash camera, which features a dual-lens full HD road-facing setup with a 140° field of view, built-in 4G LTE, and over-the-air updates, functioning alongside its core telematics hardware and an optional Vehicle Interface Module (VIM) for emergency siren/lighting mapping.

Airmax Remote Limited maintains a secure-by-design telematics platform hosted on the UK-based, PSAF-certified Microsoft Azure cloud that implements end-to-end data encryption using TLS 1.2 or 1.3 protocols, as reported on the company's official website.
claims.source: Airmax Remote Official Website Home Page (https://airmaxremote.com/)

claims.claim: Airmax Remote Limited has achieved and continuously maintained third-party certifications including ISO 27001 Information Security Management (first attained in 2019), ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and Cyber Essentials infrastructure standards.
claims.corrected: Airmax Remote Limited has achieved and continuously maintained third-party certifications including ISO 27001 Information Security Management (first attained in 2013), ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and Cyber Essentials infrastructure standards.
claims.source: Great British Fleet Event, Airmax Remote ISO accreditation article (https://greatbritishfleetevent.co.uk)

claims.claim: Airmax Remote reports that its Airmax Connect Data-as-a-Service model provides direct access to vehicle data and API integration for seamless third-party system connectivity, as demonstrated through a driver license data integration partnership with Licence Check.
claims.corrected: Airmax Remote reports that its Airmax Connect Data-as-a-Service model provides direct access to vehicle data and API integration for seamless third-party system connectivity, as demonstrated through a driver behavior data integration partnership with Licence Check.
claims.source: Fleet News, Licence Check and Airmax announcement (https://fleetnews.co.uk)

claims.claim: The company reports successful large-scale enterprise deployments, including the implementation of its RESPONSE telematics solution across the 550-vehicle emergency fleet of St John Ambulance and an active deployment partnership with e-Track rolling out to 65 sites supporting 7,000 drivers and 1,600 vehicles.
claims.source: Airmax Remote Press Releases for St John Ambulance & e-Track partnerships (https://airmaxremote.com and https://airmaxremote.com/2024/05/07/airmax-remote-and-e-track-forge-partnership-to-revolutionise-fleet-management-with-integrated-telematics-and-key-management-solutions/)

claims.claim: Airmax Remote Limited jointly announced a major strategic partnership in July 2026 with the UK Metropolitan Police Service (MPS), under which the company was appointed as the sole technology provider to supply an estimated £5.99 million comprehensive telematics platform over a 5-year contract term (4+1 years) for frontline vehicles.
claims.source: Airmax Remote Press Release and Greater London Authority Decision PCD 1979 (https://airmaxremote.com/2026/07/15/metropolitan-police-service-adopts-national-vision-for-intelligent-fleet-ecosystem-in-strategic-telematics-partnership/ and https://www.london.gov.uk/media/112605/download)

claims.claim: The company announced an exclusive, long-term agreement in June 2024 with the North Yorkshire Police to act as their strategic supplier of telematics and supply its "Airmax Response" vehicle data service platform via the CCS Framework RM6315.
Airmax Remote Limited has secured a strategic telematics partnership with the Metropolitan Police Service, announced in July 2026, to adopt its national vision for an intelligent fleet ecosystem.

Financial statements submitted to Companies House for the period ending 31 March 2025 confirm that the company maintains a healthy capital balance, with net worth growing to £1,899,932 from £1,583,582 in 2024 and total current assets standing at £2,146,302.
claims.note: Specific figures for net worth (£1,899,932, £1,583,582) and total current assets (£2,146,302) are unconfirmed.
claims.source: Companies House Registry via Pomanda/Company Check

claims.claim: Airmax Remote signed a strategic partnership agreement with Academy Pro Leasing in 2021 to provide vehicle tracking, trace, and stolen vehicle recovery services for its contract hire and high-risk underwriting fleet.
Airmax Remote announced a partnership with e-Track in 2024 to integrate vehicle telematics with electronic key management systems to optimize vehicle allocation and distribution.

A five-year contract valued at an estimated £5.99 million starting in April 2026 was awarded to the company by the Metropolitan Police Service for vehicle telematics services, according to a Mayoral Office for Policing and Crime decision publication.
claims.source: Mayoral Office for Policing and Crime Decision Publication PCD 1979

claims.claim: The company reports a historical track record of installing 250,000 systems since 1986, according to its Fleet News supplier directory profile.

Airmax Remote Limited operates from its UK headquarters located at Unit 1, Avenue Terrace, Avenue Road, Aston, Birmingham, and maintains a specialized field service capability through its dedicated internal team, the Airmax Mobile division.
The company reports providing 24/7 technical support for its emergency fleet solutions, while its standard telematics helpdesk is accessible via telephone from 08:30 to 17:30, Monday through Friday.
claims.source: Airmax Remote Support Guides and Product Specifications
